programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.desc: Hardly any other area is as unspoiled as the Yukon Delta in western Alaska. This fascinating network of swamps and river arms looks like a landscape at the beginning of mankind. Only 25,000 people live in this barren region, which is almost as big as Greece. Most of these inhabitants are indigenous and belong to the ethnic group of the Yupik. They make their living on the steep banks of the Yukon River. And in their villages, built on piles to protect them against flooding, you can see the effects of climate changes on nature - and on the community life of the indigenous population. On the trail of the national fish of Alaska, the salmon, the film follows the Yukon River and follows moose hunters, migratory birds and scientists who do research in the delta.

programme.title: Deltas of the World
programme.desc: South of Barcelona lies the Ebro Delta. Its beaches and lagoons are an exceptional refuge for migratory and native bird species. The delta is known for the numerous pink flamingos that nest near the glittering white saltworks. Sea salt is extracted and rice is cultivated in the delta. The impressive lake landscape is endangered to a certain extent by human intervention. For fear of their harvest, some rice farmers take action against flocks of birds. Invasive rice pests are also a threat to farmers in Europe's largest rice growing region. Other problems make the situation more difficult, such as climate change and rising sea levels or dams holding back sediments. What can be done to preserve the unique Ebro Delta?

programme.title: On Safari
programme.sub-title: Saseka Tented Camp, Thornybush Nature Reserve, Greater Kruger
programme.desc: Sika's seventh Safari destination is situated in the Greater Kruger area. Thornybush was one of the first Private Nature Reserves in South Africa. Set in the North-eastern portion of this Wilderness Paradise, Saseka Tented Camp is positioned on a distinct curve in the Monwana dry riverbed, which gently sweeps through this incredible landscape. A remarkable setting in the Wild that inspired visionary Designers & Architects, Silvio Rech and Lesley Carstens, to create a Safari Lodge that has a strikingly unique layout and finds a superb balance between cutting-edge design, Classical style and truly feeling connected to the outside environment.

programme.title: On Safari
programme.sub-title: FiftySeven Waterberg, Welgevonden Game Reserve, Waterberg Biosphere
programme.desc: Ending off her Romantic Safari Adventure, Sika visits Welgevonden Game Reserve set in the spectacular Waterberg Biosphere district of South Africa's Limpopo Province. Her eighth destination FiftySeven Waterberg is one of the Country's finest Boutique Safari Lodges offering the unhindered gift of glorious Nature right on its doorstep. With a firm focus on Conservation efforts, Sika experience this Game Reserve on the forefront of proactive Conservation Management and also get to relax and enjoy warm hospitality in an Oasis of 5-star Luxury within the midst of the African Wilderness.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un niño de quince años muere a causa de una misteriosa herida de bala en la cabeza mientras está sentado en el vestíbulo del club de armas de su padre.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Los residentes de Noel, Missouri, se sorprendieron al enterarse de que su banco había sido asaltado y el presidente del banco había desaparecido.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Un profesor de gimnasia de secundaria abandona misteriosamente la ciudad sin despedirse de nadie.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Cuando dos mujeres desaparecieron y luego fueron encontradas brutalmente asesinadas, la policía se preguntó si fueron víctimas de un crimen de odio.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Acechado en la noche
programme.desc: Cuando una víctima es brutalmente asesinada en su propia cama, los investigadores encuentran una huella de zapato en el barro de afuera, evidencia física que esperan que conduzca al asesino.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1996, más de una docena de niños en Seattle, Washington, luchaban por sus vidas. Cada uno de ellos había contraído una enfermedad grave desconocida. Después de que uno murió, los investigadores sabían que el reloj estaba corriendo.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: Esta examinación del papel que juegan las autopsias en las investigaciones de asesinatos se centra en la sospechosa muerte de Virginia Ridley.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1985, Julie Estes fue secuestrada de una tienda de conveniencia en Southside donde trabajaba. Su cuerpo fue encontrado al día siguiente, pero el asesinato quedó sin resolver hasta el 2003.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos
programme.desc: En 1993, Kathryn Bishop de 82 años es encontrada muerta en su hogar de Pennsylvania. Pequeñas pistas en el cuerpo de la víctima le dirán a la policía lo que pasó esa noche.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos: Dientes o Consecuencias
programme.desc: La investigación de un asesinato se ve obstaculizada por la falta de un cuerpo, pero la policía encuentra algunos restos carbonizados, incluyendo un diente cuyo relleno contiene propiedades que ayudan a los investigadores a identificar el cadáver.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: A Dog's Life S1 - "Runway Pups"

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Responsible Fishing"
programme.desc: In this episode we look at the WWF Responsible Fisheries Programme. Dr. Samantha Petersen, the programme manager, tells exactly us what this entails and Tali dons her waterproofs and sets sail where she chats to fishermen and others in the industry.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "West Coast Marine Protected Area"
programme.desc: In this episode we show just how valuable this marine protected area is.Tali meets up with a group of scientists who are doing various studies so that they can assess the fish stocks and look at what role the mpa has in managing these stocks.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "De Hoop Marine Protected Area"

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cape Agulhas"
programme.desc: Cape Agulhas is the true meeting place of the Atlantic and Indian Oceans, a place of immense cultural and natural value. Tali searches for answers to her burning questions about establishing new parks and the roles communities play in this process.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cedarberg Biodiversity"
programme.desc: Using a novel conservation model, the Greater Cedarberg Biodiversity Initiative is ensuring that the land is used in an efficient way, with the land and its inhabitants work in harmony. Tali investigate the various ways being used to achieve this.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cape Floristic Region"
programme.desc: Tali investigates the struggle to protect the Cape Floristic Region, one of the world’s 6 floral kingdoms and the only one entirely within the borders of a single country. She finds out more about why this region is in critical need of conservation.

programme.title: Keepers Of The Cape - The Issues S1 - "Cape Floristic Region"

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 3"
programme.desc: The Gosa Gang have recently moved to a new home, close to the Gosa Dam where a rival family of meerkats live. In the quest for territorial dominance, a major meerkat standoff resulted in both gangs losing a member of their tribe.

programme.desc: Recently Priscilla bought an adopted boy pup from a rival gang to the Gosa Burrow. Unfortunately, his acceptance into the Gosa group was far from ideal. The rest of the gang went out and he was left alone at the burrow, struggling for his life.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 5"
programme.desc: Summer has arrived. The Gang move to an area known as the Whispering Forest as it is the best place to find food at this time of year. However, the grass is long and there are several predators lurking such as a leopard.

programme.title: Kalahari Meerkats S2 - "Episode 6"
programme.desc: The Gosa Gang are on their way home from the Whispering Forest and bump head on into their bitter enemies. To get past them and move over the mountain a full-on war breaks out.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "The Apartment Job"
programme.desc: A fruitful break-in puts food on the table but ends in disaster when one of the troop gets a huge shock on an electricity pylon.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Fang’s Market"
programme.desc: A raid on the city fruit market seems like easy pickings until a rival gang appears, lead by the meanest macaque in Jaipur.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "The Monkey Catcher"
programme.desc: After a food raid goes wrong the monkey catcher strikes, a handful of the gang are captured and taken away in his van.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Taxi Raid"
programme.desc: The captured monkeys are released in the unknown wilderness while the rest of the gang target a car full of shopping.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Skid Row"
programme.desc: The drought means the monkey troop are facing starvation, but they are saved in the nick of time when a devout Hindu brings them bagful’s of fruit and treats.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Monsoon Showdown"
programme.desc: The monsoon finally breaks, signaling the end of the drought and the beginning of a season of plenty, leading to celebrations from monkeys and people alike!

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "One Bad Apple"
programme.desc: As India’s government clamps down on marauding macaques in the capital, Delhi, the troublemaker Zamir steals ice cream from a child, bringing the country’s leading monkey catcher racing back to Jaipur.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Return of the Rebel"
programme.desc: Cunning Zamir finds himself a new troop to join, while little Kavi is prepared for release back onto Jaipur’s streets.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "The Great Escape"
programme.desc: Kavi is released and disappears into the city, whilst Zamir and his new gang raid an office. The monkey catcher traps the troop’s alpha male, Vasu, leaving Zamir set for leadership.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Trading Places"
programme.desc: Zamir and his new troop raid a jewelry store and break into a hotel store room leading to a run-in with little Kavi, who becomes the troop’s latest recruit.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S1 - "Rising Forces"
